li.label: phantom discomfort (fading)
li.description: This body almost feels like mine now.

li.label: phantom discomfort
li.description: I keep reaching with hands I no longer have. This body is still not quite mine.

li.label: phantom discomfort (strong)
li.description: Everything feels wrong: my weight, my reach, my own face. It was my choice, but it is hard.

li.label: scar of the form-wash
li.description: They took my body. I am getting used to this one, but I will never forget what was done to me.

li.label: form-wash shock
li.description: This is not my body. Every reflection reminds me what they did.

li.label: form-wash shock (acute)
li.description: They dissolved me and poured me into a stranger's shell. I want to tear my way out of this skin.

li.label: gender shift
li.description: Sometimes I still forget that my body is different now.

li.label: gender shift (raw)
li.description: All my life I had a different body. This one does not match who I am.

li.label: superior kind
li.description: We are the true-born. The converts only wear our shape.
